subject: Request: IAM audit playbook + SCIM/SAML artifacts
messages:
From: Darren Cole <darren.cole@helixhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
Cc: security@helixhealth.com
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: IAM artifacts for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Grace,

We have a SOC 2 readiness review coming up and our audit team requested a compact "IAM audit playbook" from vendors that walks through how you demonstrate least-privilege and prove provisioning controls. Specifically Helix needs:

- SCIM delta/sync logs covering a 30-day window (user create/update/deprovision)
- Sample SAML assertions and a short explanation of attribute mappings for name/email/role
- Current RBAC role inventory and examples of role->permission mappings
- Description of how you enforce least-privilege (onboarding/offboarding, role reviews, time-bound access)

Can you confirm you can provide those artifacts and whether you can deliver an assembled playbook (PDF) we can share with our auditors? Our target is to have everything uploaded to the shared Drive by 2026-11-12.

Thanks,
Darren
Darren Cole
Senior Security Engineer, Helix Health
D: +1 415 555 0190
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
To: Darren Cole <darren.cole@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-11-02T08:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: IAM artifacts for upcoming SOC 2 review

Hi Darren — thanks for the clear list. We can provide all of this. High level:

- We will extract a 30-day SCIM delta CSV and a short readme explaining the object types.
- We'll include SAML assertion samples (redacted) + mapping table for name/email/role attributes.
- RBAC inventory (XLSX) showing built-in roles, custom roles, and permission sets; we will snapshot current assignments.
- Playbook PDF describing onboarding/offboarding processes, periodic role review cadence, and automation used to prevent standing privileges.

Could you confirm whether the auditors need ACL-level (resource-level) permission matrices or role-level mappings are sufficient? We can include an ACL extract but it will increase delivery time.

Targeting an upload to your Drive by 2026-11-10 to give you time to review before the 11-12 deadline. We will send the final pack and links once ready.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>
Cc: Darren Cole <darren.cole@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Helix Health — deliverables and owners (SCIM/SAML/RBAC playbook)

Team — Darren at Helix asked for an IAM audit playbook. I'll assemble the final PDF but need artifacts from each of you: 

Action items:
- Jonas: export 30-day SCIM delta + activity log. Please include user metadata, timestamps, and deprovision events. Deliverable: scim_delta_20261109.csv. Due: 2026-11-06.
- Naomi: run RBAC inventory export (roles, permissions, role assignments) and a short mapping sheet. Deliverable: rbac_role_inventory_20261108.xlsx. Due: 2026-11-07.
- Vivek: produce a short write-up (1 page) describing least-privilege enforcement — JIT, role review cadence, and how we detect privilege creep. Also collect any screenshots or dashboard links we can include. Deliverable: least_privilege_onepager.md (I will convert to PDF). Due: 2026-11-08.
- Marissa: coordinate redaction for any PII in SAML samples and prepare saml_assertion_samples.txt. Deliverable: saml_assertion_samples.txt. Due: 2026-11-08.

I'll assemble the playbook and upload to the shared Drive (link below) and notify Darren. If anyone expects delays, call me.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-Redwood/IAM-Audit
JIRA: SEC-9421

Thanks,
Grace
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.example>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-11-06T14:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Helix Health — deliverables and owners (SCIM/SAML/RBAC playbook)

Thanks Grace — quick status update:

- SCIM delta export completed for 2026-10-07 to 2026-11-06. File: scim_delta_20261109.csv (contains created/updated/deactivated flags, user id, externalId, email, updated_at). I redacted any provider-internal tokens.
- I also exported a short SCIM-change README that explains our idempotency keys and how we represent deprovision events.
- I ran a pass on SSO logs and pulled three example SAML assertions covering a login, logout, and attribute-change flow. Files are redacted per Marissa's guidance.

Notes for assembly: include a short note that SCIM deltas are exported from the provisioning service; the canonical source for authoritative user state is our identity store (and we included a sync check summary).

I'll drop my files into the Drive folder now and mark them for review.

-Jonas
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.example>
To: Darren Cole <darren.cole@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.example>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.example>
Date: 2026-11-10T16:42:00-08:00
Subject: Delivered: IAM audit playbook + SCIM/SAML/RBAC artifacts

Hi Darren — attaching the bundle we discussed and uploading everything to the shared Drive. Summary of what you will find: 

- iam-audit-playbook-v1.0.pdf (playbook; outlines controls, onboarding/offboarding runbooks, review cadence, and escalation paths)
- scim_delta_20261109.csv (30-day SCIM delta export; contains create/update/deprovision events)
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (3 redacted assertion samples + mapping table)
- rbac_role_inventory_20261108.xlsx (roles, permissions, and current assignments snapshot)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-Redwood/IAM-Audit
JIRA: SEC-9421 (for follow-ups and audit notes)

A couple of quick clarifications in case the auditors ask:
- Role-level mappings are included; if you need ACL-level extracts for particular resources (e.g., customer data buckets), let us know and we will run a targeted export — this will need a short lead time.
- The playbook includes our 90-day role-review cadence and an automated orphaned-account detection job that raises tickets to IT Ops.

Let me know if you want a short 30-minute walkthrough with our IAM lead (Jonas) before you hand the pack over to auditors.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachments: iam-audit-playbook-v1.0.pdf (application/pdf); scim_delta_20261109.csv (text/csv); saml_assertion_samples.txt (text/plain); rbac_role_inventory_20261108.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
